{{Quote|Professor Lancil Cordelis, the owner of the Stonewall Labs, closed the facility down some time ago.|[[Zanier Hudmasse]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />}}
[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] '''Lancil Cordelis''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Cordelis was the owner of [[Stonewall Labs]], a droid-engineering company based near [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Professor Cordelis closed the laboratory and disappeared without a trace. One year later,<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Professor [[Zanier Hudmasse]], the former Head of Research of Stonewall Labs, still ignored what happened to Lancil Cordelis.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lancil Cordelis was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lancil Cordelis was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
